quotes.text: Record if [Name] is person in whose name this accommodation is owned or rented
You told me that [NumHhldrs] people jointly own or rent the accommodation. Which of you/them has the highest income (from earnings, benefits, pensions and any other sources)?
Enter person number of the eldest (joint householder) from those listed below
Interviewer check – The Household Reference Person (HRP) has been computed as [name]

assessments.reasoning: The survey determines the Household Reference Person (HRP) using explicit algorithmic criteria. First, HRPID checks if the accommodation is owned or rented in a person's name. If multiple people jointly own or rent it, HIHNUM selects the individual with the highest income. If incomes are equal or unknown, JNTELDA/JNTELDB selects the eldest joint householder. Finally, HRPCHECK establishes that the HRP is computed based on these set rules rather than being self-declared by the household or designated arbitrarily by the respondent.
